title: Fenn and the Little Squeak-Dragon
markdown:
Fenn Pine the young ogre loved quiet mornings. The warm sun tickled his moss-green nose as he walked through the tall, green fir trees. The trees stood like sleepy giants, their branches swaying gently. The air smelled of pine needles, damp earth, and sweet berries. Fenn Pine hummed a happy, rumbly tune. He liked his walks to be calm and cosy.

Suddenly, a tiny sound fluttered through the trees. *Squeak!* It was a very small sound, like a little mouse trying to sneeze a big sneeze. Fenn Pine stopped. His big, floppy ears twitched. He tiptoed closer. His boots made soft thuds on the pine needles. He peeked behind a big, mossy stone. There, curled up in a little ball, was a dragon!

But this was not a big, fiery dragon. This dragon was very small, no bigger than Fenn Pine’s favourite teacup. His wings were thin and clear, sparkling like dewdrops on a spiderweb. The little dragon looked very, very sad. When he tried to sigh, it came out as a tiny, sad *eep*.

Fenn Pine’s heart, warm like a gingerbread cookie, felt a little bit sad too. He smiled his kindest ogre smile. “Hello there, little one,” he rumbled, his voice soft and deep like moss. The little dragon peeked out. His big, golden eyes were wide. He tried to let out a roar. But only a tiny, timid *squeak-squeak!* came out. He hid his nose under his wing.

Fenn Pine giggled. It was a warm, rumbling sound. “Oh, my!” he chuckled. “That’s a funny roar! It sounds like a little song!” He wanted to make the dragon feel better. He wiggled his big, green ears back and forth. They looked like they might fly off! Then, he made a silly face, sticking out his tongue and crossing his eyes.

The little dragon peeked out again. He saw Fenn Pine’s wobbling ears and funny face. He let out another *squeak-squeak!* This time, it sounded like a tiny, bubbly giggle. Fenn Pine tried to roar like the dragon, making a funny, wobbly *squeaky-squeak-ROAR!*

The little dragon laughed! It sounded like tiny silver bells tinkling. He stretched his dewdroppy wings. He took a big breath and let out a happy, squeaky roar: *SQUEAK-ROAR!*

Fenn Pine clapped his big hands. “That’s wonderful! Your roar is so special!” The dragon, whose name was Sparky, felt a warm glow. Being a dragon who squeaked was fun!

Sparky flapped his wings, hopping and bouncing with delight. Fenn Pine walked beside him. Their boots made soft thuds. They shared happy smiles and little squeaky roars. The fir grove felt more wondrous with their cheerful friendship.

The sunbeams grew long and golden. Fenn Pine said, “Shall we go home for some warm, cosy hot cocoa, Sparky?” Sparky nodded his little dragon head. Together, the young ogre and the little squeaky dragon padded happily through the trees, ready for a snug evening.
characters: Fenn Pine the young ogre, a little dragon
